summary: Planned Abu Dhabi office to deepen relationships with institutional investors across the Gulf Cooperation Council region TORONTO and ABU DHABI, UAE, Nov. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CIBC (TSX: CM) (NYSE: CM) today announced its intention to establish a permanent capital markets presence in the Middle East through ADGM, the international financial centre of Abu Dhabi, the capital of the UAE, subject to any required regulatory approvals. For more than 15 years, CIBC has been building relationships with institutional clients across the Middle East.
title: CIBC plans Middle East expansion with new capital markets presence in Abu Dhabi
